subject: general
question: If the third proportional of 40 and Z is 10, then what is the positive value of Z?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For two numbers **40** and **Z**, if the **third proportional** is **10**, then **Z² = 40 × 10**.

⇒ **Z² = 400**

⇒ **Z = √400 = 20**

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** First number (a) = **40**, Second number (b) = **Z**, Third proportional (c) = **10**.

**Formula Used:** If **a, b, c** are in **continued proportion**, then **a/b = b/c**, which means **b² = ac**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81d71712dd2ec7d6f555840bb08cf6474dbce7c213af620cfa6cfe32457074c6.png] 

⇒ 40 : Z :: Z : 10

⇒ 40 / Z = Z / 10

⇒ Z × Z = 40 × 10

⇒ Z² = 400

⇒ Z = √400

⇒ Z = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers **a** and **b** is calculated as **√(a × b)**.

Fourth Proportional

If **a, b, c, d** are in proportion (a:b = c:d), then the fourth proportional **d** is **(b × c) / a**.

Compound Ratio

The compound ratio of **a:b** and **c:d** is **(ac):(bd)**, obtained by multiplying corresponding terms.</p
